  • Constructor Details

    • Owner

      public Owner(String firstName, String lastName, int age, String address, String phone, String email)
      Creates an Owner with a default ID of 0. Convenience constructor for new owners before they are persisted.
      Parameters:
      firstName - the owner's first name
      lastName - the owner's last name
      age - the owner's age
      address - the owner's address
      phone - the owner's phone number
      email - the owner's email address

    • Owner

      public Owner(int id, String firstName, String lastName, int age, String address, String phone, String email, String fileName, String contentType, int fileSize, byte[] ownerImage)
      Creates a new Owner with the given attributes.
      Parameters:
      id - the owner's unique ID (must be >= 0)
      firstName - the owner's first name (required)
      lastName - the owner's last name (required)
      age - the owner's age (required)
      address - the owner's address (required)
      phone - the owner's phone number (required)
      email - the owner's email address (required)
      fileName - image file name
      contentType - image type
      fileSize - image size
      ownerImage - image byte array
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any required field is null, blank, or invalid
